review_notes: Reviewed all declarations in lines 1–175, the related `Functor.mapEquiv` definition in `Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Functor.lean`, the traversable laws in `Mathlib/Control/Traversable/Lemmas.lean`, and uses in `Mathlib/Data/DList/Instances.lean` and `Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Array.lean`. `Functor.mapEquiv` lifts an equivalence between element types within one fixed constructor; this file instead transports `Functor` and `Traversable` structures between different constructors using a family of equivalences.
